svg.aria-label: Project 04: Apply Links Telegram Bot (Python · Telethon · Groq · Flask, 2025). Reads the last 48 hours of posts from 20+ job channels, lets an LLM keep the ones that fit each student's batch, and sends them to 100+ subscribers.
